title: Understanding a Grocery Flyer
text_content:
Save-On-Foods — This Week's Deals (Sept 1–7)

Fresh chicken breast: $8.99/kg (save $3.00)
Whole wheat bread: $3.49 per loaf
Bagged apples (3 lb): $4.99 — Aisle 4
Milk (2L, 2%): $4.79

Use your More Rewards card for extra savings!
Store hours: Mon–Sat 8am–9pm, Sun 9am–6pm
All prices include applicable taxes.

questions.question: How much do you save on chicken breast?
questions.explanation: The flyer says 'save $3.00' next to the chicken breast price.

questions.question: The store is open on Sunday from 8am to 9pm.
questions.explanation: Sunday hours are 9am–6pm, not 8am–9pm. The 8am–9pm hours are Monday to Saturday.

questions.question: The bagged apples are in aisle ____.
questions.explanation: The flyer says 'Aisle 4' next to the bagged apples.

cultural_note: Canadian flyers arrive weekly by mail or in store apps. 'More Rewards' is a real loyalty program at Save-On-Foods.
